result.summary: Adds a new REST endpoint at `/rest/txspendingprevout/` exposing the functionality of the `gettxspendingprevout` RPC. The endpoint accepts up to 15 outpoints in the URI path and queries the mempool and optional `txospenderindex` for transactions spending those outputs. It supports JSON output along with `mempool_only` and `return_spending_tx` query parameters.
result.problem: Clients relying on Bitcoin Core's unauthenticated REST interface cannot query which transactions spend given outputs, forcing them to use the JSON-RPC interface even when the node has `txospenderindex` enabled.
evidence: PR description: 'This is part of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/33808, and now that sstone’s PR https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24539 is merged, I added `mempool_only` and `return_spending_tx` as query params.'
result.changed_since_previous: Added an explicit include of util/expected.h in src/rest.cpp to satisfy include-what-you-use (IWYU) requirements.
result.card: This PR adds a REST endpoint at /rest/txspendingprevout/ mirroring the gettxspendingprevout RPC method. Users and external applications querying Bitcoin Core over the unauthenticated REST interface previously lacked an endpoint to check whether outpoints were spent in the mempool or confirmed via txospenderindex without falling back to JSON-RPC. The endpoint supports batch lookups of up to 15 outpoints in JSON format with optional mempool_only and return_spending_tx query parameters. It addresses feature parity requested in issue 33808.

risk.why: A flaw in URI parsing or index query handling could cause unhandled exceptions or denial of service on the HTTP server.
